The Dandies Project 2017 – Release Party

Thu, Mar 9, 2017 · 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM · 514 Studios

Thu, Mar 9, 2017 · 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM

More: Dandies Project

We are excited to share the latest Dandie Project. Come out and meet this year’s Dandies 2017 as well as reviewing the latest Dandies lookbook, photos, and video. There will be light appetizers, drinks, and music to keep you mingling.

The lookbook will be for sale and proceeds will be going towards a local youth non-profit.

Everyone is welcome to attend this Dandies Project release party:

Thursday, March 9th
6:00pm-9:00pm
514 Studios
514 N 3rd St
Minneapolis, MN 55401

The Dandies Project is a photo project designed to highlight the positive impact that many men of color have brought to their own community not only doing it with a sense of purpose but a sense of style!!

The Dandies Project in its physical form will be a yearly coffee table book that will highlight various dandies style and backgrounds.

Our mission is simple, “giving new life to the story of the “man of color.”
